protocol.method_selection: only predeclared Task 09B frozen methods and the Task 09B selected head; no evaluation-driven selection
protocol.mic_matrix_query_policy: up to four paired query utterances per identity; each mic1/mic2 rendering uses the same source utterance IDs; enrollment utterance IDs remain disjoint
protocol.primary_reference: original Task 09B 10s enrollment, 3s grouped mic1 queries, 8-person registry, one frozen calibration threshold
protocol.speaker_roles: original Task 09B folds; 50 train/statistics, 15 selection, 15 calibration, 30 evaluation speakers per fold
protocol.threshold_policy: condition-specific calibration threshold and separately reported fixed Task 09B mic1 threshold for mic1 enrollment transfer

reference_reproduction.method_thresholds_and_decisions: reproduced by the original Task 09B evaluator on its cached NVFTR features and fixed manifest
